text:
Type: three-seat sofa bed
Use: seating, sleeping guests; living room, guest room, home office, studio apartment
Style: contemporary, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: woven fabric upholstery, pull-out bed base, dark plastic feet
Colors: burnt orange, warm coral
Shape: straight boxy frame, narrow track arms, three loose back cushions, tight flat seat, pull-out front panel, low hidden feet, long and solid
Feel: warm, bold, practical, cheerful
Goes with: white or grey walls, light wood, navy or teal accents; contemporary or Scandinavian living rooms
